known_at_rules.cpi: release_day_bound: BLS announces every release date before its release day (the 2025 and 2026 shutdown reschedules included), but the as-published annual schedule is not captured here; so a date counts only from 00:00 ET on its own day, never the day before.
known_at_rules.fomc: fed_schedule_prior_year: the Fed publishes a year's scheduled meetings during the year before (the 2026-11-13 source snapshot already lists 2027's); bound: 00:00 ET on Dec 31 of the prior year. Unscheduled meetings are not in the source and never count.
